vulnerability.name: USN-5064-3
vulnerability.description: USN-5064-1 fixed a vulnerability in GNU. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   Maverick Chung and Qiaoyi Fang discovered that cpio incorrectly handled  certain pattern files. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause cpio  to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary  code.

statements.status_notes: GNU cpio could be made to crash or run programs if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
